sloka: न ते सुविदिता देवि लोकानां स्थितिरध्रुवा ।दशाविभागपर्याये राज्ञां चञ्चलया श्रिया ।। ६.११४.९० ।।
transliteration: na te suviditā devi lokānāṁ sthitiradhruvā ।daśāvibhāgaparyāye rājñāṁ cañcalayā śriyā ।। 6.114.90 ।।

translations.english: The cowives who had come there weeping aloud and distressed, lifted up roaring Mandodari quickly.
